text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Tuesday.

- Is textile producer Varteks to lose its licence for Levi's jeans that it has made for 13 years? Reasons for this situation lie in the fact that the firm has not been fully privatised but there may be others.
- The Ron Brown memorial centre in Dubrovnik close to being completed and its opening is expected in April.
- Croatian bishops will probably not vote in the nation-wide elections on April 13, as they will be in Sarajevo for the Pope's visit.
- A full moon night between Friday and Saturday resulted in five suicides in the western sections of the country.
- The road between UNTAES checkpoint in Bilje and the Knezevo-Udvar border crossing connecting Osijek and Mohac opened to all traffic. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-4557075
